name: beans
description: Letter hints on every row of the VS Code sidebars, for Talon.

scripts.test:integration:theia: vp pack && BEANS_TEST_EDITOR=theia vp test --run --project integration

enumDescriptions: A narrower pill, close to the icon and the name.
A pill with room for two letters, with a little space around it.
A wider pill, with VS Code's own space after the icon, which is more.
beans.hintSpacing.description: How much room the hints take: the pill's width, and the space between it and the icon and the name.

beans.stableHints.description: Give each row a letter of its own that it keeps while its sidebar shows the same view, such as Explorer or Source Control, instead of lettering the rows top to bottom. Scrolling or expanding a folder then leaves the other rows' letters alone, and a row that scrolls away has the same letter when it returns. New rows get two letters once the single letters are taken. Switching the sidebar to another view forgets its letters.
